mapper.insert: insert into pm_project_member (project_id, user_id, role_id, is_project_admin, create_time, update_time) values (#{projectId}, #{userId}, #{roleId}, #{isProjectAdmin}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: select m.project_id, m.user_id, m.role_id, m.is_project_admin, m.create_time, m.update_time, u.user_name, u.nick_name, u.email, r.role_name from pm_project_member m inner join pm_project_member access_member on access_member.project_id = m.project_id and access_member.user_id = #{userId} left join sys_user u on u.user_id = m.user_id left join sys_role r on r.role_id = m.role_id where m.project_id = #{projectId} order by m.is_project_admin desc, m.create_time asc, m.user_id asc

select m.project_id, m.user_id, m.role_id, m.is_project_admin, m.create_time, m.update_time, u.user_name, u.nick_name, u.email, r.role_name from pm_project_member m left join sys_user u on u.user_id = m.user_id left join sys_role r on r.role_id = m.role_id where m.project_id = #{projectId} and m.user_id = #{userId}
select count(*) from pm_project_member where project_id = #{projectId} and is_project_admin = 1

select r.role_id as roleId, r.role_name as roleName, r.role_key as roleKey, r.role_sort as roleSort, r.status as status, r.del_flag as delFlag from sys_role r where r.role_id = #{roleId} and r.status = '0' and r.del_flag = '0'

select r.role_id as roleId, r.role_name as roleName, r.role_key as roleKey, r.role_sort as roleSort, r.status as status, r.del_flag as delFlag from sys_role r where r.status = '0' and r.del_flag = '0' order by r.role_sort, r.role_id
